## What changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Link budget: assumptions or results affected? If so, `docs/link-budget.md` and `simulations/link-budget/` agree (CI checks the baseline table).
- [ ] Requirements: any REQ-xxx changed is documented with the reason.
- [ ] Licensing: new files sit under the right path in [LICENSING.md](../LICENSING.md), or carry an SPDX header.
- [ ] Radio regulation: no change implies outdoor transmission beyond what the current regulatory decision allows.
- [ ] Measurements: raw data or a measurement issue is linked when the change relies on one.
